The engineer claims he was unfairly terminated after raising concerns related to employment conditions at Nscale’s facility. Under Norwegian law, companies must provide full rights to subcontracted personnel treated as direct employees. Nscale's operations have encountered various challenges including equipment malfunctions and contract complications.

title: Over 100 detained as SIR protests continue in Delhi
description: Hundreds of protesters including students and farmers gathered in Delhi to demand the resignation of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. They criticized the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls for resulting in unfair voter deletions. Many demonstrators were detained by police as tensions escalated during the protest. Demonstrations have been organized in 88 cities across 18 states involving numerous organizations.

title: Delhi HC junks Neha Bora plea against peace bond notice
description: The Delhi high court has denied AISA president Neha Bora's request to challenge a peace bond notice, which was raised amid concerns of potential peace disruption in a busy commercial district. The court determined that the special executive magistrate had enough evidence to issue the notice against Bora, who is facing several FIRs from the Delhi Police regarding public order violations.

title: Tests reveal Roman coffin at Westminster Abbey may hold medieval abbot
description: Excavations at Westminster Abbey have unveiled a medieval abbot's remains within an ancient Roman coffin, dated to the time between AD 987 and 1052. Notable candidates for the identity of this abbot include Ælfwig and Wulfnoth, who once steered the Westminster Benedictine monastery. The coffin, rich in history, has been preserved and examined since its 19th-century discovery, and today, visitors can appreciate its elaborate inscriptions.

title: New York family loses half its private road to 1,500-member club in court
description: In a landmark ruling, a New York family has lost their claim to a shared private road that now belongs to a nearby recreational club. This road, previously amicably used for decades, became contentious in 2021 when disagreements over access arose. The state’s highest court ultimately sided with the club, citing its historical maintenance and usage, despite the family's assertions of permission based on their long-term relationship.

title: 'Haven't seen this in a long time': Microsoft CEO on massive PHP flaw patch rush
description: Global corporations and government agencies are currently dealing with significant vulnerabilities discovered in PHP programming language. The vulnerabilities have led to millions of automated exploitation attempts shortly after the public disclosure. Leading technology executives, including Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, have expressed concern regarding software security. In response, emergency patches were released, urging users to update immediately. As a result, many organizations temporarily suspended online operations, prioritizing security measures.

title: What arriving early says about control, responsibility and stress: Psychology
description: Arriving early can reflect traits such as conscientiousness, effective stress management, or a heightened sense of social responsibility. While being punctual often signifies dependability, its emotional implications can differ among individuals. Some find solace in arriving ahead of time, whereas others experience anxiety without this practice. Grasping these behaviors requires examining the reasons behind one’s punctuality and adaptability.
